WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
      ELSE NULL
    END) as avg_amount,
    AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(avg_amount) as avg_avg_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) as avg_avg_balance
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY region
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_avg_amount) as overall_avg_amount
  FROM step2
)
SELECT 
  step2.region,
  step2.avg_avg_amount,
  step2.avg_avg_balance,
  step2.avg_avg_amount / step3.overall_avg_amount as ratio
FROM step2
CROSS JOIN step3
WHERE step3.overall_avg_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY step2.region
